pricing.billingCaveat: Annual billing saves up to 17 percent. Every plan includes one user. Extra seats cost $45-$100 per month depending on plan. AI Visibility covers one domain; additional domains cost $99 per month each. Regional pricing and taxes vary.
conflicts: Advanced plan price was listed at $549/mo but changed to custom pricing. Some third-party sources still quote the old price.

overview.tagline: Broad SEO and AI-search visibility platform with keyword, competitor, and audit tools
overview.description: Semrush is a comprehensive SEO and marketing platform offering keyword research, competitor analysis, Position Tracking, Site Audit, and AI visibility tracking. It serves SEO freelancers, agencies, content teams, and in-house marketers who need multiple research workflows in one platform.

pick: SEO freelancers and agencies with recurring client research across multiple sites
Content teams that need competitor, keyword, and optimization workflows together
Organizations monitoring multiple websites, locations, or markets
Teams that can use AI-search visibility data and prompt tracking in a defined workflow
skip: Someone who only needs an occasional keyword idea
A small site that will not use more than a few reports or projects
A team that cannot justify the plan or add-on cost
A buyer who needs a single specialist crawler rather than a broad platform

features.name: Keyword research
features.description: Comprehensive keyword research with search volume, difficulty, intent classification, and SERP analysis. Plan-specific daily keyword limits.

features.name: Competitor research
features.description: Competitor insights and broader market visibility analysis. Compare domains, identify keyword gaps, and track competitor strategies.

features.name: Site auditing
features.description: Site Audit tool crawls your website to identify technical SEO issues, on-page problems, and crawl errors with prioritized recommendations.

features.name: Rank tracking
features.description: Position Tracking monitors keyword rankings over time with daily updates, local tracking, and competitor comparison.

features.name: AI visibility tracking
features.description: Monitor brand mentions and performance in AI-generated answers from ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity. Available from Starter plan upward.

features.name: Content optimization
features.description: Content Template and SEO writing assistant provide on-page optimization recommendations based on top-ranking pages.

features.name: Backlink analysis
features.description: Backlink Audit and Domain Overview tools for monitoring link profiles, identifying toxic links, and analyzing competitor backlink strategies.

features.name: Reporting and API
features.description: Custom reporting with branded templates. API access available on Advanced plan for data integration and automation.

limitations: Website monitoring, daily tracked keywords, AI prompts, and reports are plan-specific with hard limits
API access is Advanced plan only, not available on lower tiers
AI Visibility covers one domain; additional domains cost $99 per month each
Extra seats are expensive: $45-$100 per month depending on plan
The platform's breadth creates a learning and governance burden for small teams
Search-volume, traffic, and visibility data are estimates; use them comparatively rather than as exact counts
freeAccess: Semrush offers a free plan with 10 reports per day and 1 demo project. Paid plans include a 7-day free trial. The free plan is evaluation access, not a substitute for paid workflow.

alternatives.name: Moz Pro
alternatives.whyChoose: Focused SEO tool at a lower price point. Better for teams that need core SEO without the breadth of Semrush.

alternatives.name: Ahrefs
alternatives.whyChoose: Superior backlink analysis and content research tools. Better for link-building focused workflows.

alternatives.name: Screaming Frog
alternatives.whyChoose: Specialized technical crawler with deeper site audit capabilities and one-time purchase option.

faqs.a: Semrush pricing starts at $139 per month for the SEO plan ($117.33 billed annually), $199 for Starter ($165.17 annually), and $299 for Pro+ ($248.17 annually). Advanced is custom pricing. A free plan offers 10 reports per day.

faqs.q: Is AI visibility included in every Semrush plan?
faqs.a: AI visibility features are included from Starter plan upward. The SEO plan at $139 does not include AI prompts. Starter includes 50 daily prompts, Pro+ includes 100.

faqs.q: Is Semrush worth it for one small website?
faqs.a: It can be useful if recurring competitor, keyword, audit, or AI-search research justifies the cost. If you need only occasional ideas or a single crawl, a narrower tool may be better value.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Semrush SEO and Starter plans?
faqs.a: Both plans cover 5 websites and 500 tracked keywords. The $60 difference between SEO ($139) and Starter ($199) buys AI Visibility features: 50 daily AI prompts and AI search tracking. SEO capacity is identical.

faqs.q: How many users are included in Semrush?
faqs.a: Every plan includes one user. Extra seats cost $45 per month on Starter, $80 on Pro+, and $100 on Advanced.

faqs.q: Does Semrush have a free trial?
faqs.a: Yes, Semrush offers a 7-day free trial on paid plans. A permanent free plan provides 10 reports per day with limited access.
